notes: v0.82.0 (versionCode 119) — CI android-release run 39579101136 from main at 2164562. THE GLASS RELEASE: the reference design system is now a single role contract spread across every real surface. (1) gsGlass(role, shape) — a surface asks for a role (Card / Elevated / FloatingControl / Modal / Sunken), never an alpha; each paints four optical cues in order (translucent fill, in-scattered airlight veil, directional top-leading rim, interior luminance fall) over a warm non-grey shadow. Applied to the composer, top bar, suggestion row, kit rows, drawer, search, notifications, Settings/Billing/Profile, the Home hero and the chat sheets. (2) The 12-state luminous orb: an OrbPhase presentation layer maps the twelve product states onto the nine golden dot-field geometries and lights them additively; geometry is untouched so the golden test stays green, and the glow is driven by the real microphone RMS. docs/ORBS.md rewritten. (3) Blur tiers: a real RenderEffect frost on API 31+ behind the same gsGlass call, plus a baked airlight-veil frost for API 26 (no bitmap readback). (4) iOS parity in SwiftUI — the same five roles, the 12-phase orb, and RMS computed inside AVAudioEngine.installTap (the twin of Android onRmsChanged); it compiles on real Xcode for both device (aarch64-apple-ios) and simulator. Release build verified: not-debuggable, single R8 dex, baseline profile packaged, signed with the shipping cert, public origin baked in. versionCode 119 installs over 118 without uninstalling.
knownLimitations: iOS parity compiles on real Xcode (ios-native device + simulator builds green) but the ios-native job still stops at its XCTests step: GsChatUiTests.testSendHelloRendersARealAssistantReply loads the 0.5B GGUF synchronously in GSApp.init, which blocks the main thread past the composer's 15s existence wait and then the suite's time budget on the simulator. This is a pre-existing native-test/environment condition, not a build break, and is unrelated to the Android glass release.

The android-release build OOM'd the Kotlin compiler daemon on the cold, non-incremental compile at the old -Xmx1024m; the Gradle/Kotlin daemon heaps were raised (2g / 3g) in this release, which is why run 39579101136 is the first green release build since the orb work landed.

Back gesture with the drawer open exits to the launcher on the API 30 emulator (drawer does not consume BACK there); predictive back on API 33+ likely closes it but this is UNVERIFIED product behavior pending an on-device check on a modern API device.

OpenRouter keypool remains wiped (platform wipe; operator's keys unrecoverable from disk). Sends serve via the z-ai fallback route (modelRoute=zai/gs-swift) until the operator re-supplies keys; provision via: bun scripts/provision-keys.ts "key1,key2,..."

backend availability depends on the sandbox dev server being alive; a dead server manifests as instant HTML 502 on sends. Per-launch session rotation means the app self-heals its edge routing after any backend restart.
stable-diffusion is disabled on mobile; libgs_sd.so is not shipped. Tesseract OCR is not in the APK; ML Kit is used instead.
